p: confessed: He confessed his sins, and the sins of the people.
hope in Israel concerning this thing: Meaning, that God would receive them in mercy.
all the wives: Who are strangers and married contrary to the law of God.
belongeth unto thee: Because God has given you authority and learning to persuade the people in this and to command them.
ninth month: Which contained part of November and part of December.
rain: For the season was given to rain and so the weather was more sharp and cold and also their conscience touched them.
increase the trespass of Israel: You have laid one sin on another.
make confession unto the LORD God: Read Jos 7:19.
and let all them which have: Let them be appointed to examine this matter.
were separated: They went to the chief cities to sit on this matter which took three months to finish.
their hands that they would put: As a token that they would keep their promise and do it.
Israel: Meaning of the common people: for before he spoke of the priests and Levites.
children: Who also were made illegitimate because the marriage was unlawful.
